item.title: Luxos 0.12.0 (33)
item.description:
Luxos 0.12.0

  • Let stable releases publish: the title's beta suffix stopped the script under set -e
  • Rebuild Luxos Remote for iPhone around executors, in the desktop's design
  • Redesign the app around Scenes and Playback, with executors, single cues and a real timeline editor
  • Tilt and turn effects through depth, and reverse their direction
  • Layer cues over looks; let one-shots stack and release; fix iOS release and Done
  • Switch fixtures between RGB and RGBW from the inspector
  • Add the Luxos launch site (luxos.theprism.pro)
  • Add signed releases and in-app updates (Sparkle) with Stable and Beta channels
  • Add Luxos Remote, an iPhone app that runs a shared Luxos from the room
  • Add Show mode: run the show without drawing it on the show Mac
  • Show QLab-style progress, countdown and fade on Sequence cue list rows
  • Let a QLab cue run the whole cue list or a timeline
  • Add local QLab cue synchronization with Luxos playback
  • Add remote editing (phase 2): edit the host's installation from a connected Luxos
  • Add remote sessions (phase 1): share a show, live view and playback control over the LAN
  • Add V1 installation files: Chromadance, Dopamine Entrance Tunnel, Euphoria Grove, Lumination Lane, Cushion Clash
  • Add lit surfaces, diffuser shells, pixel groups and per-wall wiring pages
  • Lay 2D canvases on the floor, add daisy-chain cables and wiring from an existing patch
  • Add 3D layout editor, wiring and power planning, scene objects, RGBW and MCP agent access
  • Fix UI lag and opening shared .luxos files
  • Add trigger cues, custom shapes, and QLab song shows
  • Add faster strobe rates and tile-aligned effect mapping
  • Add pixel mapping, bulk fixture editing, and protected background output
  • Add DMX watcher for generated, submitted, and accepted channel data
  • Add automatic tempo sync and musical accents to Music Auto
  • Add Music Auto effect with audio-driven looks and transitions
  • Add desktop audio modulation and procedural effects for 0.5.0
  • Separate Preview executable identity to restore local network output
  • Add image alpha, extended blends, and whole-group editing
  • Add linked layer groups and brightness masks
  • Add GPU composition filter stacks and native editors
  • Fix Create effect selection and functional parameter controls
  • Initial Luxos native macOS development build
